question: AI-generated 'Aura Walk' streetwear promo for a t-shirt brand. Generated from a GENERALIZED prompt (not tuned to this specific shirt). Evaluate critically: camera dynamism and framing variety (fisheye/whip/Dutch/strange angles vs a plain push-in), model movement & expressions, does the chest emblem print stay sharp and correct, is there an AURA around the PERSON (not the logo), lighting, pacing/shot variety, and AI artifacts (face/hands/logo warping, text). What specifically fails and why might a generalized prompt underperform here?

frames.description: A young man in sunglasses and a black t-shirt with a circular yellow and blue logo is seen from a low, wide-angle perspective, looking upwards. The background is dark and blurry with distant lights, suggesting an urban night setting.
A close-up, low-angle shot of the young man's face, wearing sunglasses, with a blurry background of distant lights. The fisheye lens effect is prominent, distorting the edges of the frame.

A close-up profile shot of the young man's face, looking to the right, with blurry lights in the background. His hand is slightly blurred in the foreground.

An overhead shot of a circular yellow and blue logo on a black surface, with two hands holding sunglasses over the logo, making it appear as if the logo is wearing the sunglasses. The surrounding area is dark.
